# EmailFlare

> EmailFlare is source-available email infrastructure for Cloudflare. It combines a transactional send API and a shared team inbox in one Cloudflare Worker, backed by D1, R2, KV, Queues and Durable Objects in your own account. MIT licensed.

## Product

- [Home](https://emailflare.dev/): what EmailFlare is, who it is for and how it deploys
- [Team inbox](https://emailflare.dev/inbox): shared mailboxes with threads, stars, archive and canned replies
- [Email API](https://emailflare.dev/email-api): POST /v1/send, scoped API keys, suppressions and logs
- [Templates](https://emailflare.dev/templates): built-in layouts and the Handlebars syntax guide
- [Compare](https://emailflare.dev/compare): how it differs from hosted email tools

## Documentation

- [Docs](https://emailflare.dev/docs): quickstart, authentication, sending, domains, webhooks and operations
- [API reference](https://emailflare.dev/api-reference): OpenAPI 3.1 specification, also at https://emailflare.dev/openapi.json
- [Deploy to Cloudflare](https://emailflare.dev/cloudflare): bindings, secrets and Workers Builds settings
- [Create a Cloudflare API token](https://emailflare.dev/cloudflare-token): required token permissions
